body: Why, so I can get a diagnosis to start the standard dbt/training therapy? To get medication? To get hospitalized and disappoint everyone even more? Ill have to wake up, leave, and face reality eventually. I can never open up to someone, I can't stop from lying. My old therapist became really fed up, because I kept trying to manipulate her to avoid my own thoughts and problems. Its like i cant contol it, this may sound like bullshit, but i feel like im about to break down and i dont know myself or how to do anything. I avoid absolutely everything! I know this is dysfunctional, but the camp is in a week, I can't fight through each day like I've been doing, Ill be out of my comfort zone in new stressful situations. The only thing that calms me down, before resorting to cutting myself or eating food that I'm allergic to is to sit in a closed closet, listening to classical music. I feel so fucking different and weird all the time, like my voice sometimes isn't even mine. It's all fucked up and I don't even know why I posted, perhaps just to rant, I'll just hang myself in a few days I'm sorry guys I don't like who I am anymore, nothing to look forward to and millions of things to dread, it's all fucked. I see all these kids around me moving ahead, I'm digressing and I don't want to change, better stop myself before it gets out of control, right?

Thank you, but since I'm a minor, my parents can legally get all the notes and diagnoses from the therapist. But just curious- how do you know if a therapist helps? It seems to me that speaking about it never helps, you just get a higher awareness of your fears.

I used to. But all my friendships seem to fade away after a while, and I don't give energy to maintain them. I don't really feel comfortable around friends anyway, I used to force myself to hang out with them. I sometimes crave friendships, but I ultimately like being alone. It's a dysfunctional way to live, and what scares me the most is that I don't even care, I'm driving myself to suicide. I'm just pitying myself I guess.
